latest.title: Weekend Productivity Challenge: Loop Breaker
latest.description: Loop Breaker is a serverless app that finds the tasks you keep copying from one weekly to-do list to the next, then makes you decide on each one: commit, schedule, or kill. It runs entirely on AWS. Amplify hosts the frontend, a single Lambda behind a function URL runs the backend, DynamoDB stores the boards, SQS and EventBridge Scheduler drive a weekly re-check, Amazon SES sends the results by email, and Amazon Bedrock does the judging with the Nova Micro and Nova Lite models.

latest.description: StudyPulse is a personal AI-powered productivity tool built for that exact student problem. It answers one question clearly: Where did my week actually go — and what should I do next?

latest.title: Weekend Productivity Challenge: Instanote — From Scattered Notes to a Calm, AI-Planned Day
latest.description: Instanote is an AI-powered productivity workspace that turns scattered notes, reminders, and due dates into a clear daily plan. It uses AI to prioritize the day, search and summarize notes, answer help questions through retrieval, translate notes, and prepare content for text-to-speech. The assistant can even propose creating or completing notes, but every state-changing action pauses for an explicit Approve or Deny, so the AI helps without quietly taking control.
